title: Chapter 652 - 652 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting! (2)
content:
Chapter 652 - 652 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting! (2)

Chapter 652 - 652 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting! (2)

652 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting! (2)

Then, Chen Ming showed a smile that he thought was handsome and said to Xia Xue, “Xia Xue, what a coincidence. We meet again.

“Do you like the forbidden area? When you become the department head in the future, I can bring you in too.”

It had to be said that Chen Ming was really good at grasping people’s hearts.

First, he spoke warmly and acted like a gentleman.

Then, he mentioned benefits that ordinary people could not refuse.

If it were someone else, they would definitely be easily played with.

However, Xia Xue was different.

She frowned slightly and suppressed the annoyance in her heart. “Is that so? However, I don’t like the student union. I’ll quit after a while. There are still a few members of the student union in our class. You can consider making them the department heads and then bring them to the forbidden area to do things.”

After saying that, Xia Xue could not help but secretly look at Lin Fan.

Seeing that he did not show any expression, she secretly heaved a sigh of relief.

Chen Ming was stunned.

He did not expect Xia Xue to quit the student union.

Soon, his attention fell on Lin Fan beside Xia Xue.

Chen Ming’s eyes moved slightly, and he seemed to have some guesses in his heart.

Perhaps, Lin Fan wanted Xia Xue to withdraw from the student union

Thinking of this, Chen Ming’s eyes flashed with anger.

However, his face was still very warm as he said, “Xia Xue, don’t be in a hurry to withdraw from the student union. Think about it again.”

Then, Chen Ming said, “Huh, Lin Fan?”

There was a hint of surprise in his tone.

It was as though he had just seen Lin Fan.

“Isn’t Forbidden Area No. 31 the place that Class 2011 is exploring?” Chen Ming asked after a pause. “Why is Lin Fan here?”

This sentence could not be said to have no ulterior motives.

Because Chen Ming had seen the list of Xia Xue’s classmates a long time ago. There was no one called Lin Fan.

Lin Fan did not belong to Class 2011, but now he was with Xia Xue!

One had to know…

Every year, Jiangbei University would organize students to explore the forbidden areas so that they could have the opportunity to master special abilities.

However, generally speaking, they would enter the forbidden areas in units of classes.

In addition, Jiangbei University also strictly forbade anyone from entering the forbidden areas.

Once discovered, they would be severely punished.

“Because I’m in Class 2011,” Lin Fan said casually.

“You’re in Class 2011?” Chen Ming’s voice was filled with distrust as he cast a questioning gaze at Zhang Fen.

“Lin Fan transferred to our class this semester,” explained Zhang Fen.

Chen Ming’s heart grew colder.

He was transferred to Xia Xue’s class and was also Xia Xue’s banquet companion.

Now, Xia Xue wanted to withdraw from the student union because of him.

The more Chen Ming thought about it, the angrier he became.

However, his face was full of smiles as he said, “I see. Class 2011 has Xia Xue, Zheng Zicong, and many of the student union members. They may become department heads or even the president of the student union in the future!

“I’ve always felt that Class 2011 has a very good environment to foster talents. You can also join the student union. Perhaps, you’ll have the chance to become a department head or the president of the student union.

“In this way, it will be easier to enter the forbidden area or find a job after graduation.”

After he finished speaking, he could not help but raise his head like a superior, quietly waiting for his subordinates to flatter him.

Generally speaking, the vast majority of students either wanted to enter the forbidden areas and obtain strength that surpassed ordinary people or they wanted to graduate and find a good job so that they could earn a good income.

Chen Ming directly brought up both benefits. To many people, it was definitely a great temptation.

Unfortunately, the person he met was Lin Fan.

“The student union has so many benefits?” Lin Fan asked. “But I won’t join the student union.”

When Chen Ming heard the first half of the sentence, the smugness on his face became even stronger.

He thought that Lin Fan was going to suck up to him.

However, the second half of Lin Fan’s sentence had him choking on his words.

With so many benefits, why did he not want to join?

Chen Ming coughed lightly and said, “You don’t have to reject me so quickly. There’s no harm in considering it.”

…

In the live broadcast room…

Rich Wealth: [Hahaha! I almost died laughing!]

Within Shooting Range: [I didn’t expect Lin Fan to have such a humorous side.]

Happiness: [There’ll be a chance to enter the forbidden areas if you join the student union? It would be easier to find a job? Hey, hey, hey! The core members of the Wang family of the Imperial Hotel can enter Forbidden Area No. 23. The Wang family’s family heads are so respectful to Lin Fan. How can he not enter?

[As for work? The Wang family is so respectful to Lin Fan. The employees of Yuesse Snow Tea personally brought him drinks. Why would he worry about work?]

Ten Points: [Student union president? Those who don’t know better would think that it was equal to the governor of some state.]

…

After Chen Ming was defeated by Lin Fan, he started talking to the class monitor, Zhang Fen.

Now, Chen Ming’s matter had been settled, and there was nothing else to do.

If he stayed in the forbidden area for a while longer, he might even encounter some opportunities.

In addition, with his own ability and understanding of the forbidden area, he might be able to establish a better impression of himself in Xia Xue’s heart.

Therefore, Chen Ming suggested that the student union officers return to school first while he explored the place with Class 2011.

Regarding this, Zhang Fen naturally welcomed him extremely.

This was because according to Zhang Fen’s understanding, the vice president and president of the current student union possessed extraordinary strength or extraordinary abilities…

All in all, they were people with special abilities!

In addition, Chen Ming was able to come to Forbidden Area No. 31 to do things, which meant that he knew this place very well.

From these two points, not only would it ensure Class 2011’s safety, but it would also give them more opportunities to obtain the benefits of the forbidden area.

Sure enough, with the addition of Chen Ming, everyone’s sense of security increased.

Chen Ming was the first to discover the poisonous snake in just a few hours. In addition, he chased away a wild boar.

The students who were almost injured thanked Chen Ming and praised him.

Gradually, Chen Ming became the most eye-catching person in Class 2011.

Chen Ming’s chin kept rising. He was very satisfied with the students’ reactions.

He glanced at Xia Xue from time to time.

There were a few times when Chen Ming had an illusion that Xia Xue often looked at him with admiration.

Chen Ming could not help but feel even happier. He was extremely glad that he had decided to stay and explore with the students of Class 2011.

He rejoiced, but some people secretly gritted their teeth.

One of them was Li Dongqiang.

Along the way, Li Dongqiang kept paying attention to his surroundings, just like yesterday.

He also found traces of the poisonous snake and the wild boar, but his reaction speed was half a beat slower than Chen Ming.

This led to Chen Ming solving the problems before him, which allowed him to receive a lot of thanks.

That gratitude should have belonged to him, and he would have received a lot of gratitude tokens.

Gratitude represented gratitude tokens, and gratitude tokens represented strength!

Destroying a person’s strength represented hatred, a great hatred!

A person who was not from Class 2011 had come to make enemies with him!

Li Dongqiang was furious.

Night fell…

Just like yesterday, all the students were lying in their sleeping bags.

Li Dongqiang, Lin Fan, and Xia Xue were on duty last night, so they naturally did not need to be on duty today.

Chen Ming had just joined the team today. Moreover, he was somewhat considered a guest and did not need to be on duty.

Like most of the students, he was lying in his sleeping bags

Perhaps it was because he had eaten something bad during the day, Chen Ming had just laid down for a while when his stomach started to feel uncomfortable.

He slowly got up, held his stomach, and quickly ran into the dark forest.

At this moment, Li Dongqiang, who had his eyes closed and seemed to be in a deep sleep, suddenly opened his eyes.

Then, he quickly followed Chen Ming.

Not long after, there was a dull knocking sound and a low roar in the dark forest.

“Who is it?”

“Stop hitting! Shit! I’m gonna end up sitting on shit!”

“Stop fighting!”

“Ah!”

“We’re done for!”

The sounds… gradually faded.

The woods were silent.
